intro: Most of Botswana is covered by the Kalahari, but the Okavango Delta turns part of it into a watery paradise.

chapters.title: Okavango Delta
text: The Okavango River flows inland from Angola and spreads into a vast delta that never reaches the sea. Floods arrive in the dry season, drawing huge numbers of animals.

chapters.title: Salt pans
text: The Makgadikgadi Pans are among the largest salt flats in the world. Botswana has more elephants than any other country.

keyTerms.meaning: A delta that spreads into land instead of the sea.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Botswana's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
